subject: Request: self-serve credits top-up for PLG account before expiry
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brighthealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: trial credits / approaching expiry — BH-9934

Hi Neha,

Our PLG users at BrightHealth have been testing a proof-of-concept this month and we’re almost out of the free credits that were granted at signup. The trial account (BH-9934) is due to hit zero on Jan 20th and several teams are blocked on finishing integration tests.

Can Redwood issue a small self-serve top-up or grant a short grace period while we finalize our evaluation? We’re not asking for a long extension — just enough to complete end-to-end checks and submit a procurement request.

I attached a quick usage CSV with the most active routes — hope that helps.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Director of Platform Engineering
BrightHealth

Attachment: trial_usage_summary.csv (CSV, 12 KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: trial credits / approaching expiry — BH-9934

Vivek / Marissa,

Forwarding Sarah from BrightHealth — their trial hits zero on 20th and they’re asking for a short top-up/grace so integration tests can finish while procurement confirms a purchase. They’ve been active across chat/generation routes; usage attached.

Ask: can we approve a self-serve credit top-up of $1,500 or a 7-day grace (whichever is cleaner) for BH-9934? This is a mid-market POC with clear funnel motion; permit a one-off. If you prefer, I can issue a temporary promo code via the console and track it to the deal.

Notes:
- Customer is evaluating Dedicated for later this year.
- Procurement will start next week and asked to avoid vendor invoices until they finish vendor review.

If you’re ok, I’ll send a confirmation to Sarah and create an internal approval note.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0194

---Original message attached---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: trial credits / approaching expiry — BH-9934

Neha, Marissa,

Approve the limited grant. Please issue a $1,000 self-serve credit (promo code) and set expiration for 7 days from issuance. Rationale: keeps the POC moving, limits cost exposure, and aligns with our PLG playbook for mid-market trials. Add a one-line approval note to the deal record and flag for CS follow-up.

I’m okay with promo code delivery rather than a manual credit so we have an audit trail. If the customer needs more than $1,000 after that, return to me with a usage snapshot and procurement ETA.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — East
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approval_note.txt (text, 1 KB)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brighthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: trial credits / approaching expiry — BH-9934

Hi Sarah — good news.

We’ve issued a one-off self-serve promo code that will add $1,000 in credits to your BrightHealth trial. The credit is valid for 7 days from now (expires: 2027-01-25 12:30 PST). You can redeem it in the Redwood Console under Billing -> Apply Promo.

Promo code: BH-PLG-7D-1000 (redeemable once)
What we did: issued the promo (visible in Console) and added an internal approval note tied to DEAL-7891.

Next steps for you:
- Redeem the code in the Console to restore your quota.
- If you see usage spike above the $1,000 before procurement completes, reply here and I’ll loop in Vivek for an additional review.
- I’ll follow up in two business days to confirm the integration tests completed and to help with procurement enablement if needed.

Resources: https://docs.redwood.ai/billing/promo-usage (console steps)

If you want me to issue an invoice or switch to a manual credit, we can do that after procurement finishes.

Best,
